note: Tests exercise actual imported handlers with mock Redis and Google API doubles. V2.4.5 adds 18 new suites (37-47 plus sub-suites) covering: atomic REVOKED state guard in claim/fulfill Lua scripts preventing late claims and fulfillments from overwriting revoked entitlements, concurrent duplicate RTDN deduplication, Redis failure at each lifecycle transition (fulfill, RTDN revocation, restore) failing closed, partial RTDN retry re-processing, strict Google identity validation (missing order ID, wrong order ID, substituted product ID, invalid purchase state, Google API failure), revocation audit consistency after retries, exactly-once fulfillment for consumables (no re-credit), strict lifecycle transition enforcement (FULFILLABLE→FULFILLED→REVOKED with REVOKED terminal), and restore with matching Google product ID cross-validation. Manual tests requiring Play Console, Cloud Pub/Sub, and RTDN configuration are documented but not run.
